# Test that partial_credit_model_2cats_v251224.stan and partial_credit_model_ncats_v260413.stan return identical log_lik values

This test compares the two partial credit model implementations:
- `partial_credit_model_2cats_v251224.stan` (hardcoded for 2 category types)
- `partial_credit_model_ncats_v260413.stan` (flexible for C category types)

Both models should return identical log_lik values when run on the same data with the same seed.

```{r setup, include=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(cmdstanr)
library(here)

# Source the new ncats fitting function (optional - not used in this test but available)
# source(here::here("R", "fit_partial_credit_model_ncats.R"))

# Suppress NSE warnings
item_type <- y_stan <- item_time_id <- pid <- time <- oidt <- item_label <- 
    cat_type_id <- NULL
```

## Load and preprocess Colombia data

```{r load-data, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Source data loading function
source(here::here("R", "read_data_colombia.R"))

# Define data file location
if (grepl("^/rds/general/user/or105", here::here())) {
    # Working on HPC
    dir_data <- "/rds/general/user/or105/home/WORK/2025_project_Hope_Groups/data"
} else {
    # Working locally
    dir_data <- "/Users/or105/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-ImperialCollegeLondon/OR_Work/2025/2025_project_Hope_Groups/data"
}

file_data <- file.path(dir_data, "Colombia_data_baseline_endline_itemised_250927.csv")

# Read in data from Colombia
tmp <- read_data_colombia(file_data)
dp_col <- copy(tmp$dp)
dit_col <- copy(tmp$dit)

# Preprocess data
dp1_col <- subset(dp_col, !grepl("agg", item_label))
dp1_col[, y_stan := y + 1L]

# Create item_time_id for each item_type
tmp <- CJ(
    item_label = sort(unique(dp1_col$item_label)),
    time = unique(dp1_col$time)
)
tmp[, item_type := ifelse(
    grepl("CG-MH", item_label), "categorical", "out-of-7"
)]
tmp <- tmp[
    , list(
        item_label = item_label, time = time,
        item_time_id = seq_along(item_label)
    ),
    by = "item_type"
]
dp1_col <- merge(dp1_col, tmp, by = c("item_label", "time"))
setkey(dp1_col, pid, time, item_label)
dp1_col[, oid := .I]
setkey(dp1_col, oid)

# Create observation id per item type
tmp <- dp1_col[, list(oid = oid, oidt = seq_along(y_stan)), by = "item_type"]
dp1_col <- merge(dp1_col, tmp, by = c("item_type", "oid"))
setkey(dp1_col, pid, time, item_label)

cat("Data loaded:\n")
cat("- Total observations:", nrow(dp1_col), "\n")
cat("- Categorical items:", nrow(dp1_col[item_type == "categorical"]), "\n")
cat("- Out-of-7 items:", nrow(dp1_col[item_type == "out-of-7"]), "\n")
cat("- Number of participants:", max(dp1_col$pid), "\n")
```

## Prepare data for 2cats model (old format)

```{r prepare-data-2cats}
x_formula <- ~ time - 1

stan_data_2cats <- list()
stan_data_2cats$U <- max(dp1_col$pid)
stan_data_2cats$Ncat1 <- nrow(dp1_col[item_type == "categorical"])
stan_data_2cats$Qcat1 <- max(dp1_col[item_type == "categorical", item_time_id])
stan_data_2cats$Kcat1 <- length(unique(dp1_col[item_type == "categorical", y_stan]))
stan_data_2cats$cat1_y <- dp1_col[item_type == "categorical", y_stan]
stan_data_2cats$cat1_question_of_obs <- dp1_col[item_type == "categorical", item_time_id]
stan_data_2cats$cat1_unit_of_obs <- dp1_col[item_type == "categorical", pid]
stan_data_2cats$cat1_X <- model.matrix(
    x_formula,
    data = as.data.frame(dp1_col[item_type == "categorical"])
)
stan_data_2cats$Ncat2 <- nrow(dp1_col[item_type == "out-of-7"])
stan_data_2cats$Qcat2 <- max(dp1_col[item_type == "out-of-7", item_time_id])
stan_data_2cats$Kcat2 <- length(unique(dp1_col[item_type == "out-of-7", y_stan]))
stan_data_2cats$cat2_y <- dp1_col[item_type == "out-of-7", y_stan]
stan_data_2cats$cat2_question_of_obs <- dp1_col[item_type == "out-of-7", item_time_id]
stan_data_2cats$cat2_unit_of_obs <- dp1_col[item_type == "out-of-7", pid]
stan_data_2cats$cat2_X <- model.matrix(
    x_formula,
    data = as.data.frame(dp1_col[item_type == "out-of-7"])
)
stan_data_2cats$P <- ncol(stan_data_2cats$cat1_X)

cat("\n2cats model data structure:\n")
cat("- P (predictors):", stan_data_2cats$P, "\n")
cat("- U (units):", stan_data_2cats$U, "\n")
cat("- Ncat1:", stan_data_2cats$Ncat1, "\n")
cat("- Qcat1:", stan_data_2cats$Qcat1, "\n")
cat("- Kcat1:", stan_data_2cats$Kcat1, "\n")
cat("- Ncat2:", stan_data_2cats$Ncat2, "\n")
cat("- Qcat2:", stan_data_2cats$Qcat2, "\n")
cat("- Kcat2:", stan_data_2cats$Kcat2, "\n")
```

## Prepare data for ncats model (new format)

```{r prepare-data-ncats}
# Sort data by item_type then within each type
setkey(dp1_col, item_type, oidt)

stan_data_ncats <- list()
stan_data_ncats$C <- 2L  # Two category types
stan_data_ncats$P <- ncol(model.matrix(x_formula, data = as.data.frame(dp1_col[item_type == "categorical"])))
stan_data_ncats$U <- max(dp1_col$pid)

# Arrays for each category type
stan_data_ncats$N <- c(
    nrow(dp1_col[item_type == "categorical"]),
    nrow(dp1_col[item_type == "out-of-7"])
)
stan_data_ncats$Q <- c(
    max(dp1_col[item_type == "categorical", item_time_id]),
    max(dp1_col[item_type == "out-of-7", item_time_id])
)
stan_data_ncats$K <- c(
    length(unique(dp1_col[item_type == "categorical", y_stan])),
    length(unique(dp1_col[item_type == "out-of-7", y_stan]))
)

# Total counts
stan_data_ncats$N_total <- sum(stan_data_ncats$N)
stan_data_ncats$Q_total <- sum(stan_data_ncats$Q)

# Concatenated observation data (cat1 first, then cat2)
# Create cat_type variable (1 for categorical, 2 for out-of-7)
dp1_col[, cat_type_id := ifelse(item_type == "categorical", 1L, 2L)]

# Sort by cat_type to ensure proper ordering
setkey(dp1_col, cat_type_id, oidt)

stan_data_ncats$y <- dp1_col$y_stan
stan_data_ncats$unit_of_obs <- dp1_col$pid
stan_data_ncats$question_of_obs <- dp1_col$item_time_id
stan_data_ncats$cat_type <- dp1_col$cat_type_id

# Create design matrix for all observations
stan_data_ncats$X <- model.matrix(
    x_formula,
    data = as.data.frame(dp1_col)
)

cat("\nncats model data structure:\n")
cat("- C (category types):", stan_data_ncats$C, "\n")
cat("- P (predictors):", stan_data_ncats$P, "\n")
cat("- U (units):", stan_data_ncats$U, "\n")
cat("- N:", paste(stan_data_ncats$N, collapse=", "), "\n")
cat("- Q:", paste(stan_data_ncats$Q, collapse=", "), "\n")
cat("- K:", paste(stan_data_ncats$K, collapse=", "), "\n")
cat("- N_total:", stan_data_ncats$N_total, "\n")
cat("- Q_total:", stan_data_ncats$Q_total, "\n")
cat("- cat_type range:", range(stan_data_ncats$cat_type), "\n")
cat("- cat_type is ordered:", all(diff(stan_data_ncats$cat_type) >= 0), "\n")
```

## Compile both models

```{r compile-models, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
cat("\nCompiling 2cats model...\n")
model_2cats <- cmdstan_model(
    here::here("src", "stan", "partial_credit_model_2cats_v251224.stan"),
    include_paths = here::here("src", "stan")
)

cat("Compiling ncats model...\n")
model_ncats <- cmdstan_model(
    here::here("src", "stan", "partial_credit_model_ncats_v260413.stan"),
    include_paths = here::here("src", "stan")
)

cat("Both models compiled successfully.\n")
```

## Run both models with same seed for 100 iterations

```{r run-models, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
set.seed(123)
test_seed <- 42L

cat("\nRunning 2cats model for 100 iterations...\n")
fit_2cats <- model_2cats$sample(
    data = stan_data_2cats,
    seed = test_seed,
    chains = 1L,
    parallel_chains = 1L,
    iter_warmup = 50L,
    iter_sampling = 50L,
    refresh = 10,
    show_messages = FALSE
)

cat("\nRunning ncats model for 100 iterations...\n")
fit_ncats <- model_ncats$sample(
    data = stan_data_ncats,
    seed = test_seed,
    chains = 1L,
    parallel_chains = 1L,
    iter_warmup = 50L,
    iter_sampling = 50L,
    refresh = 10,
    show_messages = FALSE
)

cat("\nBoth models completed.\n")
```

## Extract and compare log_lik values

```{r compare-loglik}
cat("\nExtracting log_lik from both models...\n")

# Extract log_lik from 2cats model
loglik_2cats <- fit_2cats$draws(variables = "log_lik", format = "draws_matrix")
loglik_2cats_mean <- colMeans(loglik_2cats)

# Extract log_lik from ncats model
loglik_ncats <- fit_ncats$draws(variables = "log_lik", format = "draws_matrix")
loglik_ncats_mean <- colMeans(loglik_ncats)

cat("\nlog_lik dimensions:\n")
cat("- 2cats model:", dim(loglik_2cats), "\n")
cat("- ncats model:", dim(loglik_ncats), "\n")

# Compute summary statistics
cat("\nlog_lik summary (mean across iterations):\n")
cat("- 2cats model: min =", min(loglik_2cats_mean), 
    ", max =", max(loglik_2cats_mean),
    ", mean =", mean(loglik_2cats_mean), "\n")
cat("- ncats model: min =", min(loglik_ncats_mean), 
    ", max =", max(loglik_ncats_mean),
    ", mean =", mean(loglik_ncats_mean), "\n")

# Compute differences
diff_loglik <- loglik_2cats_mean - loglik_ncats_mean
cat("\nDifferences (2cats - ncats):\n")
cat("- Mean difference:", mean(diff_loglik), "\n")
cat("- Max absolute difference:", max(abs(diff_loglik)), "\n")
cat("- SD of differences:", sd(diff_loglik), "\n")

# Test if they are identical within numerical tolerance
tolerance <- 1e-8
max_diff <- max(abs(diff_loglik))

cat("\n")
if (max_diff < tolerance) {
    cat("✓ SUCCESS: Models return identical log_lik values (max diff =", 
        max_diff, "< tolerance =", tolerance, ")\n")
} else {
    cat("✗ FAILURE: Models differ (max diff =", max_diff, ">= tolerance =", 
        tolerance, ")\n")
    cat("\nTop 10 largest differences:\n")
    diff_order <- order(abs(diff_loglik), decreasing = TRUE)[1:10]
    print(data.frame(
        index = diff_order,
        diff = diff_loglik[diff_order],
        log_lik_2cats = loglik_2cats_mean[diff_order],
        log_lik_ncats = loglik_ncats_mean[diff_order]
    ))
}
```

## Visualize differences

```{r plot-differences, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
library(ggplot2)

# Create comparison data frame
comparison_df <- data.frame(
    observation = 1:length(loglik_2cats_mean),
    log_lik_2cats = loglik_2cats_mean,
    log_lik_ncats = loglik_ncats_mean,
    difference = diff_loglik,
    abs_difference = abs(diff_loglik)
)

# Plot 1: Scatter plot of log_lik values
p1 <- ggplot(comparison_df, aes(x = log_lik_2cats, y = log_lik_ncats)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
    labs(
        title = "log_lik comparison: 2cats vs ncats",
        x = "log_lik (2cats model)",
        y = "log_lik (ncats model)"
    ) +
    theme_bw()

print(p1)

# Plot 2: Distribution of differences
p2 <- ggplot(comparison_df, aes(x = difference)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
    labs(
        title = "Distribution of differences (2cats - ncats)",
        x = "Difference in log_lik",
        y = "Count"
    ) +
    theme_bw()

print(p2)

# Plot 3: Differences by observation index
p3 <- ggplot(comparison_df, aes(x = observation, y = abs_difference)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = tolerance, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
    scale_y_log10() +
    labs(
        title = "Absolute differences by observation",
        x = "Observation index",
        y = "Absolute difference (log scale)"
    ) +
    theme_bw()

print(p3)
```

## Notes

For production use of the ncats model (`partial_credit_model_ncats_v260413.stan`), use the dedicated fitting function `fit_partial_credit_model_ncats()` which properly handles:

- The long vector format of `ordered_prob_by_obs` 
- The unified array format for `ordinal_brier_score[c,q]`
- Automatic data sorting and `cat_type` assignment
- Mapping of linear probability indices back to observations and response categories

See `R/fit_partial_credit_model_ncats.R` for the full implementation.
